title: trip-planner request
description: What the system sends each turn. Plain text input is read as {"kind": "message", "text": <input>}.

kind.description: message: the user wrote something. event: the system observed something on a trip in progress.

itinerary.description: The trip in progress: the last itinerary or update reply, with chosen_variant set. Its presence means the user is on the way.

profile.description: This user's stored preferences: everything earlier replies put in profile_updates.

attachments.description: Files and links the user shared: image paths readable from the working directory, or URLs (a post, a place page).

type.description: step_done: this step and all before it are behind the traveller (a taxi ordered counts as started, not done). delay: the step departs delay_min later. cancelled: the step will not happen.
